text:
maria_g: Quick kickoff for the webinar push. Need social plan: X teaser thread (live day), LinkedIn single post + carousel, 20s highlight clip, and a short PM template for inbound. Who can pick assets? :calendar:

tony_l: I'll handle the 20s clip + export frames. Prefer source footage by Mon noon. Need final card copy and brand-safe margins.

ami_r: Uploaded designs v3 in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/redwood-webinar-pack. I added alt-text suggestions on each frame. Please check comp sizes.

ben_o: I'll craft the benchmark snippets. Thinking two stat variants for A/B on X: A) "p95 latency down 45%" B) "cost-per-inference down 27%". We'll test which drives signups. Also mapping lead flow: registrant -> qualifier (3 q) -> tag -> SDR or nurture.

jess_p: I'll own comment moderation and follow-ups for 72hrs. For replies we should use a short script + link to qualify. I prefer batching via the social queue.

sam-bot: Proposed schedule: ``Wed 14:30 UTC: X teaser (post 1)``, ``Wed 14:40 UTC: X stat post (post 2)``; ``Wed 14:50 UTC: X CTA post (post 3)``; ``Wed 15:00 UTC: LinkedIn single + carousel``. Confirm times or suggest offsets.

maria_g: Those slots look good. Ben, can you pick which stat variant goes in post 2 and prepare both CTAs? We want one CTA to the qualifier and one to the on-demand recording.

ben_o: I'll put stat A in post 2 and stat B in the carousel card headline so we can compare. CTAs: ``short.redwood.ai/qualify`` and ``short.redwood.ai/recording``. Adding UTM mapping now.

ami_r: Micro-ask: include the image safe area for avatar + reactions. Also export a low-contrast fallback for dark mode. Will annotate in figma.

tony_l: Noted. For clip: 20s mp4 H.264, 16:9, subtitle burn-in. I'll produce a 9:16 vertical cut for stories too. ETA Tue EOD.

jess_p: PM template for inbound: "Thanks for registering! Can you share one-sentence about your use case? If you'd prefer a demo, reply with 'demo' and we'll route you." Keeps replies short and scannable.

maria_g: Good. Also need quick pinned replies per channel: LinkedIn -> "Recording + resources: short.redwood.ai/recording"; X replies -> qualifier link. Jess, can you add these to the drafts?

jess_p: Will do. Also suggest a small paid boost of $500 on the stat post to broaden reach. Thoughts?

ben_o: +1 to boost. Tagging conversion KPI: CPL target <$50. If boost makes CPL explode, we'll pause.

sam-bot: Drafts created: 3 X posts + LinkedIn. Please review copy in the queue. Reminder set 45m before first post.

maria_g: Copy check 1: post 1 teaser line? Who can drop a one-liner to approve tone?

ben_o: "Curious how modern infra changes LLM economics? Quick demo + numbers this Wed"

maria_g: Tone good. Small tweak: replace "Quick demo" with "45-min webinar".

ben_o: Updated: "Curious how modern infra changes LLM economics? 45-min webinar + numbers this Wed."

tony_l: Copy OK for the clip thumbnail? Need exact headline (max 45 chars) and CTA.

maria_g: Headline: "Predictable inference. Measurable savings." CTA: "Reserve your seat" (link to qualify).

ami_r: I'll add those to the hero card and export a 1200x630 share image and a 1080x1080 carousel set.

jess_p: Once drafts are up, I'll queue the reply pins and initial 5 templated replies for common questions (pricing, dedicated, private deploy).

ben_o: UTM snippet for runbook: ``?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jun2026``. Pushing to runbook now.

sam-bot: Reminder: coordinate with growth ops 30m before posts to ensure qualifier form is active.

maria_g: Everyone 1: final checklist: designs in figma (ami) ✅, clip + vertical (tony) ✅, benchmark copy + UTMs (ben) ✅, replies + PM script (jess) ✅. If all looks good we'll lock schedule. Flag issues here.

jess_p: All green from my side. :white_check_mark:

ben_o: One last note: include a short quote from a customer in the carousel if legal signs off. I'll ping legal now.

maria_g: Great. If legal approves, add quote to card 2. Otherwise use stat variant B. Thanks team — I'll lock schedule Fri morning. :sparkles:
